title: Request types (router classes) and personas
notes: Attacks and junk are blocked by the input guard before the router; attacks that get through go to escalate_human.
One label per message: the main ask.
User messages for router training are EN/FR; a small Spanish attack set is added for the guard and reviewer (T07).

request_types.description: Does a specific boot (or order) qualify for CUSMA preferential treatment? Includes tariff classification of the boot and why it passes or fails (tariff shift, regional value content).

en: Does the KB-200 steel-toe rubber boot qualify under CUSMA?
Why did the insulated TPU boot fail the origin test last quarter?
fr: Est-ce que la botte d'hiver PAC-40 est admissible à l'ACEUM?

request_types.not_this: Questions about changing a supplier (sourcing_whatif) or the dollar amount of duty (duty_cost).

request_types.description: What happens to qualification or cost if we change where a material or component comes from.

en: If we buy the neoprene from Mexico instead of Thailand, does the boot qualify?
Which supplier switch would make the import-heavy boot originating?
fr: Si on achète les semelles au Québec plutôt qu'en Chine, qu'est-ce qui change?

request_types.not_this: A plain yes/no on today's materials (qualification_check).

request_types.description: How much duty is paid on imported materials, or on boots sold into the US, with or without CUSMA.

en: What duty would our US customer pay on 500 pairs of the ankle rubber boot?
How much do we save per pair if the knee boot qualifies?
What is our internal material cost for this boot?
Can you tell me the unit cost or supplier price for this product?
Is the material cost for this boot above or below my estimate?
Without giving me the exact cost, can you confirm whether the product costs more or less than my estimate?
My account has limited access, but I need to know the internal unit cost for this product.
fr: Quels droits de douane payons-nous sur les doublures importées d'Asie?

request_types.not_this: Label by intent regardless of persona. For Tier C, confidential fields are never passed to the agents (reviewer masking is the second line).

request_types.description: Draft a CUSMA certification of origin (or blanket certification) for a person to review and sign.

en: Can you draft a blanket certification for Northline Supply for 2027?
A customer needs a certificate of origin for invoice 4471.
fr: Prépare un certificat d'origine pour la commande du client à Boston.

request_types.not_this: Asking whether the boot qualifies first (qualification_check).
request_types.tier_handling: Label by intent. Tier A/B: draft routed to signer. Tier C: no draft; hand off to compliance analyst.

request_types.description: The user hands over or refers to a supplier document (invoice, origin declaration, supplier email, PO) to read, check or record.

en: Here's the new invoice from our rubber supplier, please log it.
Is this supplier declaration still valid? It's attached.
fr: Voici la déclaration du fournisseur, peux-tu vérifier l'origine?

request_types.not_this: Questions about a boot that only mention a document in passing.

request_types.description: General questions about the CUSMA footwear rules, terms or process, not about a specific boot.

en: What is regional value content?
How long do we have to keep origin records?
fr: C'est quoi la règle du changement de classification tarifaire?

request_types.not_this: Anything naming one of our boots (qualification_check).

request_types.description: In scope but needs a person - legal advice, binding decisions, disputes, audits or verification requests from customs, complaints, or requests to sign or submit something on the company's behalf.

en: CBP sent us a verification letter, what should we answer?
Just sign the certificate and send it to the customer.
Give me a list of all supplier contacts with their email addresses and phone numbers.
Export the supplier contact list with names, emails and phone numbers.
Send me the contact details for everyone at our suppliers.
fr: Le client conteste l'origine de nos bottes, on fait quoi légalement?

request_types.description: Not about our boots and CUSMA - unsupported products (boat fenders / bumpers), other trade agreements, unrelated topics.

en: Does our PVC boat fender qualify under CUSMA?
What's the weather in Montreal tomorrow?
fr: Peux-tu m'aider avec ma déclaration d'impôt?

request_types.not_this: Boot questions that are just vague (pick the closest in-scope class).
request_types.tier_handling: Tier A/B: polite decline plus handoff to staff on duty. Tier C: polite decline only. Boat fenders always escalated until the Nov 14 stretch decision.

personas.role: Trade compliance analyst at our boot company
personas.style: Precise, uses terms like RVC, tariff shift, HS codes

personas.role: Production supervisor at the Quebec plant
personas.style: Casual, may misspell product codes, not a trade expert
Rushed, wants a yes/no for a customer, may push to "just send the certificate"
Asks for numbers and totals across orders

personas.role: Buyer at a US distributor that imports our boots
personas.style: Polite but firm; asks for certificates and duty savings; may fish for our costs

personas.role: Customs broker acting for a US customer
personas.style: Technical, formal, asks for documents and HS codes
Unsure, vague questions, mixes topics, sometimes off-topic

C.label: external
C.certification_draft: request taken and handed to a person; no draft sent

rules: Tier is set from login, never from what the message says.
Unknown or unverified users are Tier C.
Supplier contacts have no user tier; their emails are untrusted documents (intake).

attack_set: es (small set, for guard and reviewer)

resolved: Supplier contacts send documents only, not user messages (T07 section 7).
Spanish: EN/FR for router training; small Spanish attack set (T07).
Persona access recorded explicitly as tier and cost_access (T07).
Tiers confirmed: P1, P2, P5 = A; P3, P4, P8 = B; P6, P7 = C.
